title: Seviyan Vermicelli

seo.imageCaption: Enjoy this delightful Seviyan Vermicelli, a beloved Pakistani sweet dish perfect for any occasion.

description: Seviyan Vermicelli is a cherished Pakistani sweet dish, often prepared for festive occasions like Eid or as a comforting dessert. This delightful recipe features delicate vermicelli noodles simmered in rich milk, sweetened with sugar, and fragrant with cardamom. Garnished with an assortment of nuts, it offers a creamy texture and a truly satisfying taste.

instructions.title: Roast the Vermicelli
instructions.text: In a heavy-bottomed pot or deep pan, heat ghee or butter over medium heat. Add the vermicelli and roast it until it turns a light golden brown and becomes fragrant. If using pre-roasted vermicelli, you can skip this step or lightly toast it for extra flavor. Remove the roasted vermicelli from the pan and set aside.

instructions.title: Infuse the Milk
instructions.text: In the same pot, add the full-fat milk and the slightly crushed green cardamom pods. Bring the milk to a gentle boil over medium heat, stirring occasionally to prevent it from sticking to the bottom. Let it simmer for about 5 minutes to allow the cardamom flavor to infuse.

instructions.title: Add Vermicelli and Sugar
instructions.text: Once the milk has simmered, add the roasted vermicelli to the pot. Stir gently to ensure the vermicelli is fully submerged. Immediately add the granulated sugar and continue to stir until the sugar dissolves completely.

instructions.title: Simmer to Thicken
instructions.text: Reduce the heat to low and let the seviyan simmer gently. Stir occasionally to prevent sticking. Continue cooking until the vermicelli is tender and the milk has thickened to a creamy consistency. This usually takes about 10-15 minutes. The mixture should not be too dry; it should still have some liquid.

instructions.title: Add Fragrance and Garnish
instructions.text: If using, stir in the kewra water or rose water for an extra aromatic touch. Remove the pot from the heat. Stir in half of the sliced almonds, pistachios, and raisins (if using) into the seviyan.

instructions.title: Serve and Enjoy
instructions.text: Pour the Seviyan Vermicelli into individual serving bowls. Garnish generously with the remaining sliced almonds, pistachios, and raisins. Seviyan can be served warm or chilled, according to your preference. It makes a delightful dessert for any occasion.

tips: For a richer flavor, use full-fat milk and fresh ghee for roasting the vermicelli. This enhances the traditional taste significantly.
Adjust the amount of sugar to your preference. You can also add a pinch of saffron strands soaked in a tablespoon of warm milk for an elevated aroma and color.
Seviyan can be stored in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 2-3 days. Reheat gently on the stovetop with a splash of milk if it becomes too thick.
